author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000287347
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
pr (P48611, Drosophila)
PTS orthologs
* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source/propagation
The experimental mitochondrion annotation comes from a screen deposited in a database LIFE. The current IDA should have been an HDA.
I made a separate ticket to review the experimental annotation. 
I don’t think there is enough evidence for a mitochondrial localisation for PTS. This enzyme catalyses the second step of BH4 biosynthesis that occurs in the cytosol.
There is an [old paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0006291X9291804Y?fr=RR-2&ref=pdf_download&rr=a439d2aabfe4d77e) that “show" it is in the cytosol/cytoplasm (sadly the figure are all black in the pdf).
title: PAINT issue:PTN000287347 and PTS orthologs
